run_write_top_k_vasp_relaxation: run the script to generate VASP relaxation input files for the top k adsorbate-slab configurations from a sorted cache
run_write_top_k_vasp_single_point: run the script with --sp flag to generate VASP single point input files for top k configs
run_write_top_k_vasp_custom_nsw_nelm: run the script with custom --nsw and --nelm flags to configure VASP ionic and electronic step limits
run_write_top_k_vasp_paths_list: run the script to generate a paths_list.txt file listing all VASP input directories for batch DFT runs
run_write_top_k_vasp_top_k_cache: run the script to save a filtered top_k_cache_sorted_byE.pkl file containing only the best k configurations per system
